availability: Free developer preview · needs Ledge with LedgeKit 0.8.0
description: Adds Apple Music to Ledge's players and lock screen: favorite or unfavorite the playing song, add it to a playlist, and see or reorder Music's actual Playing Next. AI tools can inspect the current track, search your local music library, play a selected song, list playlists, add a selected song to a playlist, and create a playlist. They do not search the Apple Music catalog or access recommendations. Music actions need macOS Automation access. Playing Next is experimental and shows up to 12 upcoming songs.
